title: Contact form with validation and spam prevention
context: The existing contact section is a static placeholder CTA with a mailto link. Replace it with a real contact form that submits to Formspree, validates inputs client-side, and uses a honeypot field plus a 2-second time gate to prevent bot submissions.

tasks.title: Build ContactForm component and replace placeholder section
acceptance_criteria: Form renders Name, Email, and Message fields with visible labels
Submitting with any empty field shows a per-field validation error
Submitting with an invalid email format shows an email validation error
A hidden honeypot field is present in the DOM and any submission with it filled is silently rejected client-side
Submissions within 2 seconds of page load are silently rejected (time gate)
Valid submission POSTs to the Formspree endpoint (VITE_FORMSPREE_ENDPOINT env var)
A success state is shown after a 200 response from Formspree
An error state is shown after a non-200 response from Formspree
A loading/disabled state prevents double-submission while the request is in flight
Form is keyboard accessible: all fields are focusable and labelled, submit is reachable by Tab
ARIA attributes: role=alert on error/success messages, aria-invalid on invalid fields
Responsive: single-column layout on mobile, comfortable padding on desktop
App.vue placeholder contact-cta section is replaced with the ContactForm component
npm run type-check and npm run build-only both pass
